keep_apart.why: USER RULING 2026-10-25 (from the deck owner): 'I talked with the deck owner and he thinks that 10 buckets is fine. Untapped Filters, untapped colourless, Blue sources, Green sources, both, neither, skerry, galadriel, sol ring and crackle.' On red: 'Red seemed sensible, but thinking more about it this hardly ever matters or changes your mulligan decisions. Since it is very easy to get red when going off.' So the Temples are classed by blue/green only. PINS K=10: each keep_apart group takes ONE card from each of the ten buckets (a group vetoes every pair inside it), and the 11 groups together cover every cross-bucket pair, so no two buckets can merge or chain through a third card. Replaces discovery's K=9, which put the two untapped colourless lands in with Malice/Triumph. USER follow-up 2026-10-25 on that one split: 'that one is more arguable since often whether a land comes into play untapped actually isn't that relevant most of the time. K=9 is possible, but I don't think K=10 will break the bank either.' So K=9 (colourless lands back with Malice/Triumph) is an acceptable fallback if Galadriel's generation cost ever binds.
